name: Yuyuan Lisa
description: Photographs by Yuyuan Lisa — quiet moments from ordinary days, arranged by year.
heroAlt: A person on a rope swing seen from behind, looking out over the bay toward the Golden Gate Bridge.
about:
I am Yuyuan Lisa. I photograph what I pass on ordinary days: light on a wall, a window after rain, the colour of an afternoon.

I don't plan most of these pictures. I carry a camera, I notice something, and I try to keep it before it changes. The photographs here are arranged simply by time, the way they were lived.
